cases.comparison: Require AD on both replies, first A TTL <= signature lifetime, decreasing second TTL, and exactly one additional upstream A lookup.
cases.oracle: Independent ECDSA signed zone uses 300-second record TTL and a 30-second answer-signature lifetime; BIND delv validates first and the peer log counts upstream leaf queries.
cases.purpose: A validated response TTL is capped by RRSIG expiration and continues to age on a cache hit.
cases.script:
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/dnssec-ttl-bound-peer.py
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" prep || exit 98
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" serve 127.0.0.2 5340 ready 2> srv.err & srv=$!
trap 'kill "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null; wait "$res" "$srv" 2>/dev/null' EXIT
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.2 5340 || exit 98
control=$(/usr/bin/python3 "$H" control 127.0.0.2 5340 ttl-bound) || exit 98
[[ $control == control-ok ]] || { printf '%s\n' "$control"; exit 98; }
echo control-ok
count() { /usr/bin/python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("dnssec-queries.json")); print(sum(x["name"]=="shortttl.test." and x["type"]==1 for x in d))'; }
before=$(count) || exit 98
export PATH="$HOME/pbin" BASHDNS_TRUST_ANCHOR="$PWD/anchor.ds" BASHDNS_SERVER_PORT=5340
dns resolver-serve --listen 127.0.0.1 --port 5320 --root-hints 127.0.0.2 --max-queries 2 --timeout 3000 </dev/null 2> resolver.err & res=$!
/usr/bin/python3 "$H" waitudp 127.0.0.1 5320 || exit 98
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 shortttl.test A > first.out 2>&1 || exit 1
sleep 1.2
/usr/bin/dig +dnssec +adflag +tries=1 +time=10 -p 5320 @127.0.0.1 shortttl.test A > second.out 2>&1 || exit 1
wait "$res" || exit 1
after=$(count) || exit 1
/usr/bin/python3 -c 'import re,sys; a,b=(open(x).read() for x in ("first.out","second.out")); rx=r"^\S+\s+(\d+)\s+IN\s+A\s+192\.0\.2\.78$"; x=re.search(rx,a,re.M); y=re.search(rx,b,re.M); ad=lambda t: bool(re.search(r";; flags: [^;]*\bad\b",t)); ok=x and y and 0<int(x.group(1))<=30 and 0<=int(y.group(1))<int(x.group(1)) and ad(a) and ad(b); print("signed-ttl-aged=yes" if ok else "signed-ttl-aged=no"); print("cache-hit=yes" if int(sys.argv[2])==int(sys.argv[1])+1 else "cache-hit=no")' "$before" "$after"
cases.setup_script:
mkdir -p "$HOME/pbin"
ln -s /opt/bashos-parity/candidate "$HOME/pbin/bash"
printf "nameserver 127.0.0.2\n" > resolv.conf
mkfifo w.fifo
